assign.request: ext/Playground: kill the hover jank (zero layout shift on any hover), gate + and resize handles on selected+hover, allow repeated adds, fix the column-drag writing width instead of height, labels on hover raised clear of the box, make the blocky + button-like.
assign.now: scoping - read brief, canvas.js, playground.css, Playground.js
steps: Probe: baseline jank + column-drag bug on a throwaway doc
Kill the jank: reserved in-flow space for .pg-add, opacity gate
Selected+hover gating for + and resize handles
Labels: hover-only, raised, zero flow impact

log.msg: BASELINE measured (pgint-base/steps.json, 3-level doc on slug pgmm-interact): every hover shifts .pg-viewport +37px height and back -37px. Nested: row children lose 18px width each (the rows own in-flow + becomes a COLUMN in the row); column children lose 19px height each. Six hovers, six shifts, zero exceptions.

assign.now: designing the fix - reserved in-flow + for stacks, abs-pos + for rows/grids

log.msg: PROOF 1 zero jank (pgint-hover/steps.json): 12 hover steps over 6 nodes, unselected AND selected, every watched rect delta 0 - dx dy dw dh all zero on all ten watched selectors. Baseline was +37px viewport on every one of six.

PROOF 2 multi-add (pgint-add/steps.json). Stack flank: click (739,462) selects the empty Box (0 kids); THREE more clicks, first at the SAME PIXEL, give 1/2/3 kids with selected_is_pad true every time. Row flank: one click in a gap selects the row, then three clicks at the SAME fixed pixel (950,162) give 4/5/6 kids, selected_is_row true every time - the abs + never moves, so repeated adds need no mouse move at all.

DECISION selection: add_to (a PLACE) keeps the container selected; add() (the toolbar verb) selects the new item as before. That keeps the canvas + lit for repeated clicks and leaves the documented 2026-08-19 add-then-remove fix intact on the toolbar path. Two one-line rules, no flag, no new API.

TRAP for the ui-test skill: LiveReload.changed() is called with NO path by Directory.js, which means reload everything - so any sibling agent adding a file under public/ full-reloads the headless page mid-plan and kills the run with Execution context was destroyed. Fix: re-acquire state in every eval via import(...).then(m => m.default.tool) and carry a stamp so a silent reload is visible in steps.json.

assign.now: proof 3+4 - drag axes and handle placement

log.msg: PROOF 3 drag axes (pgint-drag/steps.json). COLUMN, vertical drag +50px: c1 data went {width 120px, height fill} -> {width 120px, height '', basis 0, grow 3.56} - width UNTOUCHED, height is what moved. Rects: c1 dh +50 dw 0, c2 dy +50 dh -50 dw 0. ROW, horizontal drag +60px: r1 {width 100px} -> {width 160px}, exactly +60; rects r1 dw +60 dh 0, r2 dx +60 dw -30 dh 0. Cross axis is 0 on both flanks.

The width bug demonstrated live on the item before the fix landed in the drag path: setting width 71px on a COLUMN child renders 'padding: 0.25em; width: 71px; align-self: flex-start; flex: 1 1 0' - items.js size_decls puts width on the CROSS axis in a column, so the old commit's height-in-pixels went straight to the visible width. That is the owner's report, mechanism confirmed.

FOUND the real 'resizers in the wrong place' bug, and it was NOT the jank. set_viewport() changes one CSS variable - no data change, no repaint, no position_handles() - so a preset switch left the r2|r3 handle 143px from its gap, and a hover did not recover it (measured). Fixed at the cause with one ResizeObserver on .pg-viewport in canvas.js (set_viewport itself is out of fence): preset 768/full/400 all settle to 0.01px one frame later. Same observer covers window resize and rail-grip drags, which had the identical bug and nobody had noticed.

PROOF 4 handle placement (pgint-handles/steps.json): offset from each gap's true centre, all five handles, after gap 0 / 1em / 2em / 3em and after three viewport presets - worst 0.01px. Also removed a pre-existing systematic 1.00px error on EVERY handle: position_handles measured from the container's BORDER box but left/top resolve against its PADDING box, so subtract clientLeft/clientTop.

MEASURED .pg-node-empty verdict: KEEP. An empty .pg-stack box is 32px with the rule and 32px without it (reserved + is 22px, padding 8px, border 2px) - a measured no-op there. But an empty row-Flex or Grid carries its + absolutely, so the rule is still its only floor: 32px vs .pg-node's bare 24px. One line, still earning it.

Label decision: plain :hover, not selected+hover. A label answers 'what am I pointing at', which you want BEFORE committing to a click; an ACTION belongs to the box you already chose. Raised from -1.1em to -1.5em of its own 0.7em font (-11.6px to -15.8px measured), which clears the node's top border by ~3px instead of sitting on it. Absolute either way, so no gating choice can move a rect.

Toolbar path re-verified after the selection change (pgint-clean/steps.json): add() into a selected container selects the NEW item; add() with a plain Box selected adds a sibling into its Flex parent and selects it. Unchanged, as intended.
CLEANUP: test doc pgmm-interact deleted via pg.delete_current() - gone from public/data/playground/ and from index.json; the owner's untitled and untitled-2 untouched. Never gestured on either.

WISHES for wave 2 (out of my fence). (1) doc/decisions.md + readme.md want the new gate written down: affordances are selected+hover, labels are hover, .pg-stack decides in-flow vs abs +, and add_to keeps the container selected. (2) A container whose children cover it edge-to-edge with gap 0 can no longer be selected by a canvas click at all (it never could, but the gate makes it matter) - the tree is the only way in. That is exactly the clickable-edge inserter's territory; left clean. (3) set_viewport() should probably call position_handles() itself; the ResizeObserver covers it from canvas.js, but the direct call is the honest one.

assign.outcome:
**Zero layout shift on any hover** - measured, not claimed. Plus the column-drag width bug, repeated adds, and the real cause of the misplaced resizers.

| | before | after |
|---|---|---|
| hover any node (12 hovers, 6 nodes, unselected + selected) | `.pg-viewport` **+37px** every time; row children **-18px** wide, column children **-19px** tall | **0px** on every watched rect, every step |
| click a container's `+` three times | new child stole the selection, container's `+` vanished | **3 children, container still selected** every click; the row's abs `+` never moves, so three adds land on ONE pixel |
| vertical drag in a `column` flex | committed the height into `width` -> box visibly narrowed (`width: 71px` on the cross axis) | `width` **untouched** at 120px; `height` cleared, `basis`/`grow` written. Rects: `dw 0` both flanks |
| horizontal drag in a `row` flex | ok | r1 `100px` -> `160px`, exactly +60; `dh 0` both flanks |
| handle placement after a viewport preset change | **143px** off its gap, and a hover did **not** recover it | **0.01px**, one frame later, at 768 / full / 400 |
| handle placement after gap 0 / 1em / 2em / 3em | 1.00px off, systematically, all five | **0.01px** |

![](before-hover-jank.png)
*Before: one hover on `r2` grew the viewport 37px and squeezed both siblings.*

![](after-stack-plus.png)
*After: the reserved, button-like `+` on a stacked container. Its room is always there, so revealing it moves nothing.*

![](after-row-plus.png)
*A row container gets its `+` absolutely, in the corner - six children added at a single unmoving pixel.*

**Decisions**
- `.pg-add` is **always in flow and always laid out**; only `opacity` moves. `.pg-stack` (a Box or a column Flex - canvas.js) keeps it in flow with its room reserved; a row Flex or a Grid would owe it a whole column or cell, so theirs is absolute in the corner. Zero shift by reservation on one side, by construction on the other.
- **Gate:** `+` and resize handles on `.pg-selected:hover`; labels on plain `:hover` - a label answers "what am I pointing at" and you want it *before* you commit; an action belongs to the box you already chose. `pointer-events` follows opacity, so a hidden `+` cannot eat the very click that reveals it.
- **Selection:** `add_to` is a *place* and keeps the container selected (that is what makes repeated adds work); `add()` (the toolbar) stays a *verb on the selection* and selects the new item, preserving the documented 2026-08-19 add-then-remove fix. One line each, no flag.
- **The drag fix** is the main-axis key (`row ? "width" : "height"`) at all three sites in `resize_handles`.
- **The misplaced resizers were never about hovering.** `set_viewport()` is one CSS variable - no repaint, no `position_handles()` - so a preset switch stranded a handle 143px away. One `ResizeObserver` on `.pg-viewport` in canvas.js answers the whole class (preset, window resize, rail-grip drag) at the moment geometry moves. Also removed a systematic 1.00px error: `position_handles` measured from the border box but `left`/`top` resolve against the padding box.
- `.pg-node-empty` **kept**, measured: a no-op for a stack (32px with the rule, 32px without) but still the only floor for an empty row-Flex or Grid (32px vs 24px).

**Left deliberately**
- `readme.md` / `doc/decisions.md` (out of fence, wave 2): the new gate, `.pg-stack`, and the `add_to` rule want writing down.
- `set_viewport()` should call `position_handles()` itself; the observer covers it from inside the fence, but the direct call is the honest one.
- A container whose children cover it edge-to-edge at gap 0 can only be selected from the tree - that is the clickable-edge inserter's territory, left clean.
- Test document `pgmm-interact` created and deleted; the owner's documents were never touched.
